-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This script looks at the overlap of unique species maps and GHCN weather station cold spots
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
library(oce)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(tools)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggnewscale)
```



```{r}

# Bat families to exclude in the second run
bat_families <- c("Pteropodidae", "Phyllostomidae", "Vespertilionidae", 
                  "Molossidae", "Emballonuridae", "Megadermatidae",
                  "Rhinolophidae", "Myzopodidae", "Noctilionidae")

process_family_overlap <- function(fam_dir, coldspot_path, out_dir, expr_csv_path, proj_name, analysis_type = "terrestrial",
                                   exclude_families = NULL, run_label = "") {
  cat("\n======================================================\n")
  cat("Starting Overlap Analysis for:", proj_name, run_label, "\n")
  cat("======================================================\n")
  
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  all_files <- list.files(fam_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
  fam_list <- all_files[grepl(analysis_type, basename(all_files))]
  cat("Found", length(fam_list), "files matching '", analysis_type, "'\n")
  
  if (length(fam_list) == 0) stop("No family .tif files found in ", fam_dir)
  
  GHCN_coldspots <- rast(coldspot_path)
  ref_rast <- GHCN_coldspots
  area_rast <- cellSize(ref_rast, unit = "km")
  
  # GHCN_coldspots <- project(GHCN_coldspots, crs(ref_rast))
  # GHCN_coldspots <- resample(GHCN_coldspots, ref_rast, method = "near")
  
  area_rast <- cellSize(ref_rast, unit = "km")
  
  family_df <- data.frame(
    full_path = fam_list,
    base_name = basename(fam_list),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(family_expression = base_name) %>%
    mutate(family_expression = sub("\\.tif.*", '', family_expression)) %>%
    mutate(family = sub("_.*","", family_expression)) %>%
    mutate(expression_label = sub("^[^_]+_","", family_expression)) %>%
    distinct()
  
  expression_df <- read.csv(expr_csv_path) %>%
    select(-X) %>%
    group_by(family, analysis) %>%
    filter(analysis == analysis_type) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    distinct()
  
  fam_express_df <- left_join(family_df, expression_df, by = "family") %>%
    filter(!is.na(count))
  
  # exclude families if specified
  if (!is.null(exclude_families)) {
    n_before <- nrow(fam_express_df)
    fam_express_df <- fam_express_df %>% 
      filter(!family %in% exclude_families)
    n_after <- nrow(fam_express_df)
    cat("Excluded", n_before - n_after, "families. Remaining:", n_after, "\n")
  }
  
  coverage_results <- data.frame(
    family = character(),
    num_species = numeric(),
    coverage_area_km2 = numeric(),
    coldspot_area_km2 = numeric(),
    overlap_area_km2 = numeric(),
    overlap_percent = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(fam_express_df)) {
    fam_file_path <- fam_express_df$full_path[i]
    family_file <- fam_express_df$base_name[i]
    fam_avail <- fam_express_df$family_expression[i]
    num_species <- fam_express_df$count[i]
    
    if(is.na(num_species)) next 
    
    cat("Processing:", family_file, "(Species count:", num_species, ")\n")
    
    rast_layer <- rast(fam_file_path)
    rast_layer <- project(rast_layer, crs(GHCN_coldspots))
    rast_layer <- resample(rast_layer, GHCN_coldspots, method = "near")
    
    family_cells <- (!is.na(rast_layer) & rast_layer > 0)
    coverage_area_km2 <- global(area_rast * family_cells, sum, na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
    
    coldspot_area_km2 <- 93350000 # this number is obtained from the weather_stations.RMD script
    
    overlap_rast <- rast_layer * GHCN_coldspots
    
    overlap_cells <- (!is.na(overlap_rast) & overlap_rast > 0)
    overlap_area_km2 <- global(area_rast * overlap_cells, sum, na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
    
    overlap_percent <- (overlap_area_km2 / coldspot_area_km2) * 100
    
    coverage_results <- rbind(coverage_results, data.frame(
      family = fam_avail,
      num_species = num_species,
      coverage_area_km2 = coverage_area_km2,
      coldspot_area_km2 = coldspot_area_km2,
      overlap_area_km2 = overlap_area_km2,
      overlap_percent = round(overlap_percent, 2)
    ))
    
   non_na_cells <- global(!is.na(overlap_rast), fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
    
    if (!is.na(non_na_cells) && non_na_cells > 0) {
      
      max_value <- global(overlap_rast, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
      

      min_value <- 0 
      
      if (!is.na(max_value) && max_value > min_value) {
        overlap_rast <- (overlap_rast - min_value) / (max_value - min_value)
      }
      

      overlap_rast[overlap_rast == 0] <- NA
      
      out_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(fam_avail, "_GHCN_overlap_", num_species, ".tif"))
      cat("Overlap:", round(overlap_percent, 1), "% of coldspots. Saving to:", out_path, "\n")
      writeRaster(overlap_rast, out_path, overwrite = TRUE)
    } else {
      cat("No overlap found. Skipping.\n")
    }
  }
  
  coverage_results <- coverage_results %>% arrange(desc(overlap_percent))
  
  cat("\n====== TOP 10 FAMILIES BY COLDSPOT OVERLAP ======\n")
  print(head(coverage_results, 10))
  
  csv_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("coverage_results_", proj_name, "_GHCN", run_label, "_touches1957.csv"))
  write.csv(coverage_results, csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Coverage results saved to:", csv_path, "\n")
  
  cat("\nFinished processing", proj_name, run_label, "!\n")
  return(coverage_results)
}

# RUN THE FUNCTION WITH DESIRED PROJECTION AND BAT FAMILIES INCLUDED OR EXCLUDED




expr_csv <- read.csv("expression_df_2026_1957.csv")

# --- Mollweide: ALL families ---
cov_moll_all <- process_family_overlap(
  fam_dir = "family_maps/mollweide",
  coldspot_path = "GHCN_terr/coldspots/ws_moll_final_coldspot2.tif",
  out_dir = "GHCN_terr/GHCN_overlap/mollweide",
  expr_csv_path = "expression_df_2026_1957.csv",
  proj_name = "Mollweide",
   analysis_type = "terrestrial",
  exclude_families = NULL,
  run_label = "_all"
)

# --- Mollweide: WITHOUT bats ---
cov_moll_nobats <- process_family_overlap(
  fam_dir = "family_maps/mollweide",
  coldspot_path = "GHCN_terr/coldspots/ws_moll_final_coldspot2.tif",
  out_dir = "GHCN_terr/GHCN_overlap/mollweide_nobats",
  expr_csv_path = "expression_df_2026_1957.csv",
  proj_name = "Mollweide",
   analysis_type = "terrestrial",
  exclude_families = bat_families,
  run_label = "_nobats"
)

# --- EPSG:4326: ALL families ---
cov_4326_all <- process_family_overlap(
  fam_dir = "family_maps/esri_4326",
  coldspot_path = "GHCN_terr/coldspots/ws_4326_final_coldspot2.tif",
  out_dir = "GHCN_terr/GHCN_overlap/esri_4326",
  expr_csv_path = "expression_df_2026_1957.csv",
  proj_name = "EPSG4326",
   analysis_type = "terrestrial",
  exclude_families = NULL,
  run_label = "_all"
)

# --- EPSG:4326: WITHOUT bats ---
cov_4326_nobats <- process_family_overlap(
  fam_dir = " family_maps/esri_4326",
  coldspot_path = "GHCN_terr/coldspots/ws_4326_final_coldspot2.tif",
  out_dir = "GHCN_terr/GHCN_overlap/esri_4326_nobats",
  expr_csv_path = "expression_df_2026_1957.csv",
  proj_name = "EPSG4326",
   analysis_type = "terrestrial",
  exclude_families = bat_families,
  run_label = "_nobats"
)


```
